pose: Majestic upright posture. Neck extended vertically without any bending. Massive, rounded body with a thicker neck than a Diplodocus. Full vertical fill, with the head positioned near the top of the 1024px frame.

environmental_details.ground: Soft, damp, earthy ground with visible clay textures, reflecting the 'clay master' style.
environmental_details.flora: Sparse, large-leafed prehistoric plants and ferns, creating a lush but open jungle feel, allowing sunlight to penetrate. No dense, overgrown canopy.
environmental_details.sky: Bright, clear sky visible through an open jungle canopy.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Soft, sun-drenched lighting filtering through the leaves, emphasizing the rounded, clay-like surfaces of the Brontosaurus.
